svg.title: Quantum threat model — Hyperledger Fabric v2.5.12
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing quantum-vulnerable operations across six Fabric components, severity-encoded by color, with five threat scenario overlays and a severity legend.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What quantum-vulnerable operations does the Fabric Client SDK perform, and which threat scenarios target it?')
sendPrompt('What quantum-vulnerable operations does the Endorsing Peer perform, and why is it rated Critical?')
sendPrompt('Why is the Ordering Service block signing operation the most consequential quantum vulnerability in Fabric?')
sendPrompt('What are the Critical quantum operations at the Committing Peer (Op-14 to Op-16)?')
sendPrompt('Explain threat scenario TS2: Transaction Signature Forgery')
sendPrompt('Explain threat scenario TS4: TLS Session Decryption via Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later')
sendPrompt('Why is the Fabric CA root certificate the highest-priority quantum harvest target?')
sendPrompt('What are the Critical quantum operations in the Fabric MSP (Op-21, Op-22)?')
sendPrompt('Explain threat scenario TS5: Gossip Protocol Manipulation')
sendPrompt('Tell me about TS1: Identity Impersonation via Certificate Forgery')
sendPrompt('Tell me about TS2: Transaction Signature Forgery')
sendPrompt('Tell me about TS3: Block Integrity Compromise via Orderer Key Recovery')
sendPrompt('Tell me about TS4: TLS Session Decryption via Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later')
sendPrompt('Tell me about TS5: Gossip Protocol Manipulation')

svg.text: Critical — network-wide integrity compromise (8 operations: TS1, TS3)
High — transaction or identity forgery within a channel (10 operations: TS2)
Medium — inter-node confidentiality breach via HNDL (7 operations: TS4, TS5)
